jobs.title: Intern - Associate Business Intelligence Analyst (Grid Resiliency)
jobs.description:
Dominion Energy is committed to providing reliable, affordable, and increasingly clean energy that powers our customers every day. If you want to work for a purpose-driven company that values safety and collaboration, we’re looking for you. You won’t just find a job here; you’ll find your career. Review the position below and apply today.

At this time, Dominion Energy cannot transfer or sponsor a work visa or employment authorization for this position.

Job Summary

This internship will provide direct support to the Electric Distribution Grid Resliency group. This is an exciting time for Dominion as the company is currently engaged in large-scale energy infrastructure construction projects along with multiple in-house projects supporting Dominion's existing power distribution and reliability.

This position provides real-life examples to assist the individual in understanding principles in data analysis, modeling and data science.

Gains skills related to Business Performance, Finance, Systems, Operations, and Engineering solutions. Learns entry level aspects of data governance, cataloging, data acquisition, data quality, data analysis, data interpretation, and interactive data visualizations. This includes support of business metadata, business rules, and influence remediation of data quality defects. Ability to work as part of a cross-functional team to analyze business requirements, assist with the development of model strategies or solutions.

Required Knowledge, Skills, Abilities & Experience

The position requires a solid understanding related to data driven performance technologies and tools, process, metrics and analytics.

Intern should possess:

- Solid skills commensurate with grade level

- An inquisitive nature and curiosity

- Ability to follow written and verbal procedures

- Strong professional ethics

- Oral and written communication skills, including technical writing

- Planning, organizing, and project management skills

- Effective decision-making skills

- Ability to coordinate multiple tasks simultaneously

- Basic computer skills and proficiency in software programs

- Analytical and abstract thinking skills

- Ability to apply data analytics theories and concepts to industrial problems

Education Requirements

- Student must be enrolled in 4-year degree program. Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems Technology or related field preferred.

- Students must have a graduation date of Spring 2028 or later.

- Must have a 2.5 GPA or greater.

- Must possess a valid driver's license.

Test Description

No Testing Required

$21.00 - $29.00

jobs.title: ET Protection & Control System Field Compliance Specialist
jobs.description:
Dominion Energy is committed to providing reliable, affordable, and increasingly clean energy that powers our customers every day. If you want to work for a purpose-driven company that values safety and collaboration, we’re looking for you. You won’t just find a job here; you’ll find your career. Review the position below and apply today .

Military service members and veterans with ranks from E5-E9, W1-CW5, or O3-O6, plus appropriate equivalent combination of education and years of experience as outlined below will be considered for this opportunity.

Job Summary

Independently perform difficult and complex work requiring thorough knowledge of the subject matter and significant experience within the Electric Transmission Field Operations (ETFO) Cyber Security Program. Responsible for providing expert technical and engineering support, direction and advice for the development of projects, programs and operational technology products. Responsible for providing training to field personnel on cyber security and compliance initiatives, applications and tools.  Works closely with Power Delivery and generation support organizations, interfaces with all groups in IT support organizations, contribute to the development of cyber security strategies and implement threat prevention and mitigation capabilities while maintaining a heightened awareness of the ETFO cyber security landscape. Manage and proficiently utilize cyber security systems deployed in protection of Power Delivery assets; including remote engineering systems, account management systems, asset inventory systems, change management, network intrusion detection, file security, anti-virus, and firewall rule management. E valuate, integrate and enhance remote engineering systems (ESNET, Power System Center). Coordinate patch management and cyber asset management by facilitating periodic meetings to align activities and ensure revised policies and procedures are effectively communicated. Ensure that baseline configuration documentation is developed and/or revised to meet NERC CIP requirements. Recommend and support the implementation of architectures necessary to maintain Power Delivery cyber security and compliance.

Analyze potential cyber security incidents, security alerts and assist ITRM cyber security personnel in following incident response procedures. Develop technical procedures to maintain adherence to the NERC/CIP program. Coordinate with IT for firewall rule change requests and network equipment upgrades on the control system network as needed. Schedule work using the Transmission Outage Authorization (TOA) system, ability to forecast upcoming deadlines and schedule accordingly.

Required Knowledge, Skills, Abilities & Experience

At least 7+ years of experience (with Bachelor's;  9+ years with Associate's degree) in Information Technology/Operations Technology (IT/OT), cyber security, network design, firewall rule development, and management of Windows operating systems security or ten years of a combination of this experience and ICS experience.
Must have a detailed ‘hands on’ understanding of cyber security processes and technologies, network perimeter controls including next generation firewalls, switches, and malware prevention, security technologies including network intrusion detection systems, firewalls, logging and monitoring tools, antivirus tools, malware prevention, incident response and recovery tools, asset inventory systems and security analytics platforms; incident analysis, root cause analysis, and problem resolution
Strong understanding of NERC CIP standards and requirements.
Must have a strong understanding of ETFO Cyber Security program and its application and of ICS networks.
Must have a thorough understanding of automated and manual patch management systems.
Experience in security aspects of multiple platforms, operating systems, software, communications, and network architecture and topologies.
Must have a strong understanding of vulnerability assessment tools (i.e. NMAP, NESSUS, and Wireshark).
Must have a detailed ‘hands on’ understanding of multiple Substation Communications/Relay protection platforms and architectures.
Must be proficient in control print reading and understanding Substation layouts.
Must have a strong understanding of various Substation Communications/Relay devices and architectures.
Must have working knowledge of SAP and PowerBase asset management systems.
Must have a strong understanding of substation awareness including a working knowledge of substation design, architecture, physical security measures, electronic security measures, and safety best practices.
Must have expert knowledge in modern and legacy communication protocols (dial-up, VSAT, TCP/IP, Cellular).
Must be able to utilize critical thinking skills and apply Human Performance tools to all tasks and assignments.
Strong level of understanding of network security principles, technologies, best practices, and NIST ICS guidance.
Excellent analytical and problem solving skills.  Ability to work independently and in a team environment to identify errors, pin point root causes, and devise solutions with minimal oversight.
Strong leadership, interpersonal skills, verbal and written communication skills;

Education Requirements

Degree or an equivalent combination of education and demonstrated related experience may be accepted in lieu of preferred level of education:

Bachelor

Preferred:

Computer Science

Electrical Engineering

Engineering Technology

Information Technology

jobs.description:
Dominion Energy is committed to providing reliable, affordable, and increasingly clean energy that powers our customers every day. If you want to work for a purpose-driven company that values safety and collaboration, we’re looking for you. You won’t just find a job here; you’ll find your career. Review the position below and apply today .

Military service members and veterans with ranks from E3-E5, W1-W2, or O1-O3, plus appropriate equivalent combination of education and years of experience as outlined below will be considered for this opportunity.

At this time, Dominion Energy cannot transfer or sponsor a work visa or employment authorization for this position.

This position does not offer relocation assistance.

Job Summary

In support of the Company's SOX programs, this role maintains the cyber regulatory compliance program for business units' processes, applications, and systems. Using cyber security best practices and a deep knowledge of cyber regulatory requirements, this role:

Specific responsibilities include:

- Provides guidance on how to achieve compliance, governs and monitors the entire program; can offer technical guidance or assess technical procedures for compliance; reduces or eliminates audit findings; implements changes and ensures adherence to all regulatory requirements.

- Can lead and participate in compliance-related projects that require advanced knowledge of regulatory requirements as well as knowledge of suitable security architecture, technology best practices and business area requirements, limitations, and unique system implementations.

- Monitors the implementation of compliance processes and procedures for systems and applications.

- Examines processes for failure points and implements controls to prevent those potential failures.

- Coordinates or completes compliance related data requests, investigates failures or breakdowns in processes and develops plans to fix or prevent future incidents.

- Proactively finds opportunities to strengthen compliance controls.

- Provides awareness of current and upcoming policies, regulations, and requirements, and collaborates with business and technical teams to develop an approach to achieve compliance.

- Perform other duties as requested or assigned.

Note:  This position will work at the Thomas Farrell Building in Richmond, VA.

Associate Cyber Compliance Analyst: 0 to 3 years of cyber or IT audit, compliance, or technology experience (Note: A Master's degree will count as one year of experience; a partial year of experience of six months or more will be rounded up to one year)

Cyber Compliance Analyst:   3 to 4 years of cyber or IT audit, compliance, or technology experience (Note: A Master's degree will count as one year of experience; a partial year of experience of six months or more will be rounded up to one year)

Specific knowledge, skills, abilities and experience:

- Experience with SOX or other regulatory compliance is desired;

- Experience and understanding of Cyber regulatory standards and requirements;

- Previous experience creating and updating cyber & human performance controls for compliance requirements;

- Experience working with internal and external auditing firms;

- Experience in writing procedures and policies;

- Experienced translating procedures into operational steps;

- Root cause analysis understanding and/or training;

- Human performance failure analysis training and/or understanding;

- Understands IT Technology and Business Technology as required to successfully design and implement a compliance program;

- Understands current security architecture best practices;

- Understands current cyber security best practices;

- Possesses the drive to independently learn and become an expert in the evolving regulatory landscape and how that maps to an evolving Dominion Energy IT and business technology landscape.
